channel.title: The MacEx Journal
channel.description: Practical ideas for a calmer Mac.

item.title: A file naming system for Mac that you can actually keep using
item.description: Make project files easier to recognize with a simple subject, date, and version pattern. Includes examples for invoices, drafts, screenshots, and shared work.

item.title: Finder Smart Folders: keep a project view without moving your files
item.description: Build a saved Finder search for active work, understand what Smart Folders actually store, and choose rules that stay useful as your projects grow.

item.title: How to find a file on your Mac when you forgot its name
item.description: Turn the clues you remember into a useful search: file type, approximate date, likely location, and content. A practical workflow for Finder and MacEx.
